verdict.rationale: Conductor documents cloud workspaces shared with the whole organization, created from a repo branch, pull request, or GitHub/Linear issue. Teammates can open them, follow the conversation, and pick up the work. However, these are per-task coding workspaces that get archived after merge, not a persistent team source of truth, and nothing shows docs being ingested into a workspace. Missing for 10: creating a workspace from documentation sources, a persistent shared knowledge or source-of-truth workspace spanning docs and repos, multi-repo workspaces, and independent hands-on corroboration of team sharing.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team

citations.quote: Workspaces and chats are shared with your organization, so a teammate can open the same workspace, follow the same conversation, and pick up where you left off.
create a workspace from a branch, pull request, GitHub issue, or Linear issue.
The link opens the workspace in Conductor for any member of the organization.
